name: Shard of an Infernal
summary: Menara Voidrender in the Barrens needs you to use the Infus Emerald on an Infernal in Desolace. Bring her the emerald and the imprisoned spirit.

sections.title: An Infernal Spirit
sections.body: The spirit is the next thing Menara Voidrender asks you to bring back to the Barrens. In Desolace, use the Infus Emerald on one of the Infernals; afterward, return to Menara with both the emerald and the imprisoned spirit.

faq.q: What does Menara want me to do?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender asks you to use the Infus Emerald on an Infernal in Desolace, then bring her the emerald and the imprisoned spirit in the Barrens.

faq.q: Where do I use the Infus Emerald?
faq.answer: Use the Infus Emerald on one of the Infernals found in Desolace.

faq.q: What do I bring back to Menara?
faq.answer: Bring Menara Voidrender the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit.

attribution: In-game quest text: Shard of an Infernal
